name: thailand-geological-map
title: Thailand Geological Map
notes:
Simplified geological units of Thailand served from the POC GeoServer over WMS, plus an external (federated) WMS resource.

**Note:** the local layer is *illustrative* synthetic data generated for this proof of concept; it is not a real geological survey product.
resource_description: Layer amconnect:thailand_geology published by the POC GeoServer from PostGIS.

extra_resources.name: OpenStreetMap (external WMS, terrestris)
extra_resources.description: Federated example: a third-party WMS endpoint that is not hosted in this stack.
